ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels (~80%) with a localized high-intensity (white/light-grey) region (~20%) situated on the right distal lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-colored geometric region on the right lobe spanning from the mid-section to the distal tip. Scattered low-diameter (2-15 pixel) high-contrast circular blobs (mottling) distributed across the left lobe and the periphery of the right lobe's dark sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees; vertical depth relative to total fluke height is approximately 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. A series of deep, jagged peaks and valleys are concentrated on the distal 25% of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory sweeping postero-distally towards the tips; the overall aspect ratio shows moderate tapering of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of small (sub-10 pixel radius) white circular clusters distributed non-uniformly; highest concentration observed on the medial-to-distal section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, near-vertical low-contrast linear disruptions (possible rake marks) detected on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large yellowish-tan pigmentation anomaly localized within the white patch of the right lobe. Asymmetrical trailing edge profile with a significant indentation on the right lobe approximately 2/3 from the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The primary light-colored patch on the right lobe contains multiple internal dark-pixel islands and a visible gradient from white to yellow-tan pigmentation.
